function	script	F_GetJROCard	{

	.@roll = rand(10000);

	// ============================================
	// Ultra Rare (0.25%)
	// ============================================
	if (.@roll < 25) {

		.@rarity$ = "Ultra Rare";
		.@rate$ = "0.25%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			300137,300138,
			27127,27128,
			27344,27345;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	// ============================================
	// Rare (0.50%)
	// ============================================
	else if (.@roll < 75) {

		.@rarity$ = "Rare";
		.@rate$ = "0.50%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			27069,27070,27068,27075,27078,27076,27080,
			27072,27073,27071,27074,27079,27077,
			27055,27056,27057,27058,27059,27060,
			27061,27062,27063,27064,27065,27066,27067,
			300224,300225,300226,
			300356,300357,300358,
			300451,300452,300453,
			300502,300503,300504,
			300615,300616,300617;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	// ============================================
	// Common (1.50%)
	// ============================================
	else if (.@roll < 225) {

		.@rarity$ = "Common";
		.@rate$ = "1.50%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			27021,27022,27023,27024,29230,
			31006,31007,31008,31009,31010,31011,31012,31013,31014,31015,
			27050,27051,27052,27053,27054,
			27129,27130,27131,27132,27133,27134,27135,27136,
			27137,27138,27139,27140,
			27364,27365,27366,27367,
			300131,300132,300133,300134,300135,300136,
			300163,300164,300165,300166,300167,300168,
			300282,300283,300284,300285,300286,300287,300288,300289,
			300410,300411;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	else {
		return 0;
	}

	getitem .@card,1;

	announce "[Old Card Album] "+strcharinfo(0)+
		" obtained "+itemlink(.@card)+
		" ("+.@rarity$+" - "+.@rate$+")!", bc_all;

	return .@card;
}

function	script	F_GetJROCardM	{

	.@roll = rand(10000);

	// ============================================
	// Ultra Rare (0.50%)
	// ============================================
	if (.@roll < 50) {

		.@rarity$ = "Ultra Rare";
		.@rate$ = "0.50%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			300137,300138,
			27127,27128,
			27344,27345;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	// ============================================
	// Rare (1.00%)
	// ============================================
	else if (.@roll < 150) {

		.@rarity$ = "Rare";
		.@rate$ = "1.00%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			27069,27070,27068,27075,27078,27076,27080,
			27072,27073,27071,27074,27079,27077,
			27055,27056,27057,27058,27059,27060,
			27061,27062,27063,27064,27065,27066,27067,
			300224,300225,300226,
			300356,300357,300358,
			300451,300452,300453,
			300502,300503,300504,
			300615,300616,300617;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	// ============================================
	// Common (3.00%)
	// ============================================
	else if (.@roll < 450) {

		.@rarity$ = "Common";
		.@rate$ = "3.00%";

		setarray .@Pool[0],
			27021,27022,27023,27024,29230,
			31006,31007,31008,31009,31010,31011,31012,31013,31014,31015,
			27050,27051,27052,27053,27054,
			27129,27130,27131,27132,27133,27134,27135,27136,
			27137,27138,27139,27140,
			27364,27365,27366,27367,
			300131,300132,300133,300134,300135,300136,
			300163,300164,300165,300166,300167,300168,
			300282,300283,300284,300285,300286,300287,300288,300289,
			300410,300411;

		.@card = .@Pool[rand(getarraysize(.@Pool))];
	}
	else {
		return 0;
	}

	getitem .@card,1;

	announce "[Mystical Card Album] "+strcharinfo(0)+
		" obtained "+itemlink(.@card)+
		" ("+.@rarity$+" - "+.@rate$+")!", bc_all;

	return .@card;
}
